title: LC-MT372-LocusEndToEndDiagnosticsManualGate
clause: Prove the rebuilt Locus project forest end to end through product runtime, GUI, Argus, diagnostics and built-in manuals.

scope.summary: GOAL: Execute the independent Locus acceptance gate after MT-371. In a clean Handshake runtime backed only by managed SurrealDB, create a representative forest containing a coding-app root, creative image-crawl subproject, CKC character-sheet task, LoRA prototype and a separate Tailor/ComfyUI-related project. Give each node its own taskboard/WPs/MTs, add authorized cross-project dependencies, run parallel claims and leases, use Notes/Loom typed backlinks, restart, corrupt a projection, repair it, archive/restore a node and prove privacy. The scenario illustrates capabilities without treating those example domain/module relations as mandatory project ancestry. Complete operator UI, Argus evidence, three-tier diagnostics and no-context human/model manual coverage.
forbidden_paths: SQLite/PostgreSQL runtime, fallback, fixture or proof path
Administrative credentials used as privacy proof
UI screenshots without canonical state reconciliation
Treating example product modules as implicit project hierarchy
acceptance_criteria: A clean runtime creates, navigates and operates the representative root/subproject/task/prototype forest with independent project-owned taskboards/WPs/MTs and unambiguous project-qualified identities.
Authorized cross-project dependencies, readiness, parallel claims, leases and execution-context replacement behave correctly before and after restart with independent SurrealDB rereads.
Notes/Loom backlinks expose typed project/WP/MT connections while canonical lifecycle remains Locus; corrupting or deleting projections is detected and repaired without changing truth.
Authenticated users prove same-project, parent/child, cross-project and denied-AccessSpace behavior without names, counts, occupancy or blocker leakage.
Argus verifies readable/discoverable hierarchy, taskboards, blockers, occupancy, diagnostics and recovery; human and model manuals let a no-context operator reproduce normal and recovery workflows.
Independent scans prove zero connected SQLite/PostgreSQL Locus code, dependencies, fixtures, configuration or validation paths.
proof_targets: Full production-boundary Locus managed-project scenario against a clean managed SurrealDB
Canonical state/event/outbox/projection reconciliation before and after restart
Argus visual suite at required states and viewport sizes

enforcement_boundaries: Production privacy proof uses authenticated record users only.
GUI, search, rollups, blockers, diagnostics and Flight Recorder obey the same ResourceBroker authorization.
same_project_private_resource_cases: The E2E matrix proves a same-project user cannot access another private AccessSpace through any Locus or Loom surface.
cross_account_negative_cases: The E2E matrix proves cross-account denial across direct reads, forest navigation, taskboards, search, blockers, occupancy, diagnostics and recovery.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: All GUI, Loom, taskboard, rollup, search, diagnostic and evidence projections preserve canonical source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: E2E revocation and Principal/project context switches invalidate prior queries, subscriptions, cached views, claims and recovery actions.
metadata_side_channel_cases: No denied names, counts, ownership, occupancy, blocker detail, timing signals or hidden project existence leak through any operator/model surface.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: All Locus project, governance, dependency, projection, claim, recovery and privacy-verdict events have stable correlated ids.
The Locus diagnostic bundle exposes canonical health, ledger/outbox parity, projection drift, graph integrity, leases, subscriptions and legacy tripwires.
End-to-end closeout requires the available Palmistry health/watch surface to observe stalls, drift and recovery; any unavailable producer blocks this gate rather than being silently skipped.

risk_if_missed: Locus could pass component tests while remaining confusing, inaccessible, privacy-unsafe or unrecoverable in the actual multi-role IDE and creative-tool workflow.

risks: UI displays stale projection as truth.
A denied project leaks through rollup/search/occupancy.
Example domain hierarchy is mistaken for project hierarchy.
Manual omits recovery or parallel-agent behavior.

research_provenance.source: Operator-approved 2026-08-27 Handshake IDE/creative-tool and managed-project examples; MT-361..371 contracts; current HBR visual/manual/diagnostic requirements; official SurrealDB production-boundary guidance.
research_provenance.selected_approach: One representative multi-domain project-forest scenario proving canonical state, parallel work, typed Loom links, privacy, recovery and operator/model usability.
